objects.taxonomy_description: Fabric bag with two parallel shoulder straps for carrying on the back. The main compartment is a rectangular or rounded pouch (30-55 cm tall) made of nylon, canvas, or polyester with a zipper or drawstring closure. Materials range from smooth synthetic fabric to textured canvas. Colors vary widely. The bag exhibits bilateral symmetry with straps positioned symmetrically on the back panel.

objects.taxonomy_description: Large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India with a distinctive tawny coat. Males have a prominent shaggy mane ranging from blonde to dark brown surrounding the head and neck. Coat is short, dense, and uniform tawny with a lighter underside. Body is large, muscular, and well-proportioned with powerful legs and a long tail with a dark tuft at the end. Head is broad with a short muzzle. Ears are small, rounded, and erect. Eyes are medium-sized, round, and amber to brown with an intense expression. The breed's signature features include the male's distinctive mane, social pride behavior, and tawny coat with tail tuft.

objects.taxonomy_description: Fleet equine mammal measuring 120-150 cm at withers with distinctive black-and-white striped coat pattern. Stripes unique to each individual, extending across body, legs, and mane. Head elongated with large dark eyes and mobile ears. Neck arched with erect bristly mane. Body robust and muscular. Legs long and slender terminating in single dark hooves. Tail long with black tufted hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. African equine with herd behavior. Stripes serve as camouflage and fly deterrent.
